## About Me

::: {.about-profile}
![](images/D11D0880-A8DF-4557-A6F9-FE4EF84821B0.PNG){.profile-photo}
:::

Hi, I’m **Jian He**, a full-time biostatistician.

My current study and research interests focus on **Mathematics**, **Causal Inference**, **Survival Analysis**, and **Distribution-free Inference**.

## What I Do

I work at the intersection of statistics, biostatistics, and applied biomedical research, with a particular interest in:

- **Mathematics** — single variable calculus, real analysis, probability, and statistical theory
- **Causal Inference** — potential outcomes, treatment effects, mediation analysis, and heterogeneous treatment effects
- **Survival Analysis** — time-to-event outcomes, censoring, Cox models, competing risks, frailty models, and joint models
- **Distribution-free Inference** — rank-based methods, permutation tests, nonparametric inference, and conformal inference
- **R Programming** — reproducible statistical analysis, simulation, visualization, and reporting

## About This Website

**SkywalkerHe's Knowledge Fortress** is my personal study-notes website.

The purpose of this website is to organize my long-term learning in mathematics and biostatistical methodology. I use it to collect definitions, theorems, derivations, examples, statistical interpretations, and reproducible code.

This website is built with **Quarto** and hosted on **GitHub Pages**.
